subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should existing custom DeepInfra native video endpoints remain a supported configuration, or may this PR deliberately retire them in favor of OpenAI-compatible video endpoints?
rationale: The current shipped behavior and docs use the native endpoint, while the proposed Doctor migration can prove compatibility only for DeepInfra’s own host; deciding whether custom operators may lose the old protocol is a product and upgrade-policy choice.

options.title: Preserve custom native compatibility
options.body: Define an explicit supported configuration contract for custom native video endpoints while using the new OpenAI videos flow for compatible endpoints.

options.title: Retire custom native endpoints
options.body: Accept the breaking change, make the Doctor output and public upgrade documentation prominent, and require a manually configured OpenAI-compatible replacement endpoint.

recommendation.title: Preserve custom native compatibility
recommendation.body: Define an explicit supported configuration contract for custom native video endpoints while using the new OpenAI videos flow for compatible endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct engagement, and this is an upgrade-policy decision rather than a narrow provider implementation defect.
